description: This file defines Express.js routes for analytics-related endpoints in a backend server, handling cost by agent, active user trends, and new users over time, with authentication and tenant verification middleware.

methods.name: head /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Health check endpoint for LLM cost by agent, responds with 204 and specific headers.

methods.name: options /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Preflight OPTIONS request handler for the same endpoint.

methods.name: GET /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Retrieves cost data by agent after verifying authentication and tenant requirements, with CORS headers.

methods.name: GET /users/active-trend
methods.description: Fetches active user trend data with authentication and tenant checks.

methods.name: GET /users/new-over-time
methods.description: Fetches new users over time data, protected by authentication and tenant verification.
